incident.what: We misconfigured a backup copy of order records, and anyone on the internet could read it for 3 hours.
incident.found: Tue 17 Nov, 04:05, by our own monitoring
incident.data: Customer names, phone numbers and order totals. No passwords, codes or payment details.
incident.done: Closed the copy at 04:12, checked the access logs (2 requests, both from our own scanner), and changed the keys to the storage it was in.
incident.your_steps: Nothing is needed from you. If you want to tell your customers, a draft notice is ready in the console for you to edit and send.
